fields.name: IMO
fields.label: IMO number
fields.description: The unique 7-digit identification number assigned to the ship by the International Maritime Organization (IMO). Mandatory for linking the electricity delivery record to the correct vessel under MRV, DCS, and FuelEU Maritime frameworks.

fields.name: EDN_Id
fields.label: EDN id
fields.description: A persistent, unique internal system identifier assigned to a specific electricity delivery event for the vessel. Ensures lifetime traceability of shore power connections across database platforms.

fields.name: EDN_Number
fields.label: Electricity Delivery Note Number
fields.description: The official Electricity Delivery Note (EDN) number provided by the shore power terminal. Acts as the primary regulatory receipt identifier for cold ironing operations.

fields.name: Electricity_Delivery_Date
fields.label: Electricity Delivery Date
fields.description: The Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) date marking the finalization and disconnection of the onshore power supply (OPS) service.

fields.name: Electricity_Delivery_Time
fields.label: Electricity Delivery Time
fields.description: The Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) time marking the exact finalization of the onshore power supply (OPS) connection.

fields.name: Electrical_Work
fields.label: Electrical work delivered
fields.description: The total electrical energy delivered to the vessel from the shore grid, measured in kilowatt-hours (kWh). Essential for verifying compliance with FuelEU Maritime zero-emission port stay mandates.

fields.name: WtT_Electricity_Cf
fields.label: Well-to-Tank emissions factor
fields.relevance: out of scope for GHG verification
fields.description: The Well-to-Tank (WtT) emission factor for the supplied electricity, expressed in g/kWh. Relevant for advanced lifecycle greenhouse gas (LCA) accounting for specific green power contracts.

fields.name: Sustainability
fields.label: Sustainability
fields.relevance: out of scope for GHG verification
fields.description: Reference identifier for a Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) or Guarantee of Origin (GoO), verifying the renewable or sustainable generation source of the shore-side electricity.

fields.name: Port_Of_Reception
fields.label: Reception port
fields.description: The standardized 5-letter UN/LOCODE representing the specific commercial port facility where the shore-side electricity connection was established and utilized.
